mapper.select: SELECT id, item_code, item_name, variant, hierarchy, item_model, unit_retail, mvc, category_l1, category_l2, category_l3, sync_flag, deleted_flag, created_at, updated_at FROM consignment_item_setup WHERE item_code = #{itemCode} AND deleted_flag = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consignment_item_setup ( item_code, item_name, variant, hierarchy, item_model, unit_retail, mvc, category_l1, category_l2, category_l3, sync_flag, deleted_flag, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{variant}, #{hierarchy}, #{itemModel}, #{unitRetail}, #{mvc}, #{categoryL1}, #{categoryL2}, #{categoryL3}, #{syncFlag}, #{deletedFlag}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (item_code) DO UPDATE SET item_name = EXCLUDED.item_name, variant = EXCLUDED.variant, hierarchy = EXCLUDED.hierarchy, item_model = EXCLUDED.item_model, unit_retail = EXCLUDED.unit_retail, mvc = EXCLUDED.mvc, category_l1 = EXCLUDED.category_l1, category_l2 = EXCLUDED.category_l2, category_l3 = EXCLUDED.category_l3, sync_flag = EXCLUDED.sync_flag, deleted_flag = EXCLUDED.deleted_flag, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
